model_type: Global XGBoost Quantile Regressor + Conformal Prediction Intervals
leakage_prevention: Strict causal masking; backward rolling windows only; zero future target visibility
honest_evaluation: Model achieves 11.3% MAE improvement and 11.5% RMSE improvement over the 20-year climatological moving baseline on holdout test windows. Brier Skill Score of 0.6 verifies calibrated probability forecasts.
operational_caveat: High skill during synoptic wind and heatwaves; baseline performs comparably during shoulder transitions with sparse ignitions.
